title: committee
description: A group of roles, from any parties, that owns steps together. Each member has one RACI letter, and the members marked A are jointly accountable. A committee belongs to no party.

id.description: Unique id: lower-case letters and numbers joined by hyphens, e.g. bid-board. Used as a step's owner.

name.description: The committee's display name. It can't be the same as a role's name.

summary.description: One or two sentences about what this committee decides.

members.description: At least one member role id, each to one letter: A (shares the decision, jointly accountable), R (does the work), C (consulted) or I (informed), e.g. partner-manager: A.

status.description: How this element differs from today.

today.description: How it works today, shown next to the future state.
